profile.target: NOAA Science On a Sphere site-custom dataset

hardware.validation: Direct sphere testing requires an installation and operator; the no-hardware fallback is the verified frame inventory and offline viewer.

limitations: The package has not been tested on sphere hardware, so seam, orientation, physical legibility, and operator workflow remain unproved.
The export path has not yet been witnessed by a learner or presenter other than the implementer.
Browser interaction and typography are represented by the complete globe frames and external context files rather than projected as interactive controls.
